On a key match the value string is copied into the output buffer a3 (returns 0); on a miss or empty table the input key a2 is copied into a3 instead (returns -1). Null key/value pointers fall back to a default string at byte_5EA438.

On match, load the value pointer at the matched entry (table + 16*mid + 8); if null substitute the default string byte_5EA438.
Copy the matched value string byte-by-byte into the output buffer a3 using a null-terminator-scanned copy loop.
Return 0 on a successful match, -1 on a miss.
